title: Add Status Page
content: Create status page layout. Header: company logo, "System Status" title, overall status badge (All Systems Operational - green). Current status: list of services, each with name and status indicator (green dot = operational, yellow = degraded, red = outage). Incident history: timeline of past incidents with dates and descriptions. Subscribe: email input to get status updates.

variants.simple: Create system status page with service status indicators.
variants.detailed: Create status page layout. Header: company logo, "System Status" title, overall status badge (All Systems Operational - green). Current status: list of services, each with name and status indicator (green dot = operational, yellow = degraded, red = outage). Incident history: timeline of past incidents with dates and descriptions. Subscribe: email input to get status updates.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive status page. Overall status: large banner showing current status (Operational, Degraded, Partial Outage, Major Outage) with color coding. Component groups: organize services by category (API, Web App, Database, CDN, etc), each with individual status. Status indicators: operational (green), degraded performance (yellow), partial outage (orange), major outage (red), maintenance (blue), unknown (gray). Uptime display: 90-day uptime bar chart per component, percentage uptime. Current incidents: active incidents with severity, title, status (investigating, identified, monitoring, resolved), timestamps, updates timeline. Scheduled maintenance: upcoming maintenance windows with date, time, expected duration, affected components. Incident history: past incidents grouped by date, expandable for full details and update history. Response metrics: average response time charts, latency by region. Subscribe: email and webhook subscriptions, notify on all updates or specific components only. Embed: widget code to embed status on other sites. API status: public API for programmatic access. Time display: show times in visitor timezone. Refresh: auto-refresh with last updated timestamp. Incident communication: markdown support for updates, affected components list. Historical uptime: monthly/yearly uptime reports. Accessibility: status conveyed by more than color (text, icons).
